main.content:
== Knowledge Graph ==

BITwiki functions as a knowledge graph, connecting ideas to implementations through explicit semantic relationships. This structure enables powerful navigation and discovery features.

=== Graph Structure ===

The knowledge graph connects different types of pages:
* Ideas - Theoretical concepts and foundational knowledge
* Implementations - Actual projects and practical applications
* Domains - Knowledge areas that organize content
* Concepts - Specific terms and definitions

=== Relationship Types ===

Key relationship types in the knowledge graph:
* Support relationships - Ideas that support implementations
* Implementation relationships - Projects that implement ideas
* Related relationships - General knowledge connections
* Categorization relationships - Domain-based organization

=== Visualization ===

The knowledge graph can be visualized using:
* Semantic queries that generate dynamic lists
* Graph visualization tools integrated with MediaWiki
* Navigation templates that show related content
* Category trees that display organizational structure

=== Navigation Features ===

Knowledge graph navigation includes:
* Dynamic lists of related content
* Faceted browsing by properties
* Semantic search across relationships
* Pathfinding between connected concepts

=== Maintenance ===

Maintaining the knowledge graph requires:
* Regular review of semantic relationships
* Updates when new content is added
* Correction of broken or outdated links
* Expansion of relationship types as needed

This knowledge graph approach transforms BITwiki from a simple collection of articles into a connected web of knowledge that reflects the relationships between theoretical concepts and practical implementations.
